children: Polymarket Engineering Vice President @devjoshstevens said Polymarket Perps is now live and open to all users. According to ChainCatcher, the product is a new exchange built from scratch in Rust, designed for retail and professional traders, and can be integrated through an SDK. The post also invited product feedback.

title: Polymarket Launches Perps Exchange Built in Rust
